fieldNotes.location: Roster coords moved 1613m and resolved to a Century Foods / Hormel nutritional-products plant on Century Court, Sparta WI, off Hwy 16 / next to a Canadian Pacific rail mainline. Confirmed via web search (Hormel 'Our Locations', 400 Century Court) and matching industrial layout. Locked center 43.94255,-90.79120.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No gate or perimeter fence on the truck side. Century Court (private drive) runs straight onto the open paved truck yard; Street View (2025-08) shows no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point. Open uncontrolled access.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere along the access road or at the building.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - no gate exists, so no remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Counted ~6-8 trailers backed in along the NW building face plus dock doors along the NE corner; ~18 total estimated, 10-25 band. Trees partly obscure the count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large gravel/dirt drop lot east of the building with ~25-30 trailers parked in angled rows; dropArea = 25-50, dedicated drop yard present.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long open paved approach from Century Court into the yard; easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.railServed: A multi-track rail mainline runs along the NW property edge but no spur enters the building - the plant backs up to the tracks with no rail dock. railServed = false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant/office building plus a small detached storage building near the NW tracks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Small-town edge of Sparta WI, surrounded by woods, a golf course, and farmland - clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity concentrated on adjacent NW and NE faces around one yard - treated as a single combined ship/receive operation.

citations.claim: Hormel Our Locations lists Century Foods International, Sparta WI (nutritional products / dairy proteins).
Century Foods International appears in Hormel FY2025 10-K subsidiaries (Exhibit 21.1).

verification.rationale: Hormel acquired Century Foods (Sparta WI) Oct 2024; on Hormel locator + FY2025 10-K subsidiary list; no negative.
